bugs.title: Add Customer form fails when email is left blank (not marked required in UI, but rejected by backend)
bugs.evidence: Browser: customer-create-search-workflow check - modal stays open after Simpan, console logs 'Failed to load resource: 422 (Unprocessable Entity)' x2. Backend cross-check: curl -X POST /api/customers with email:"" returns 422 'value is not a valid email address: An email address must have an @-sign.' The React form (Customers.tsx) defaults/keeps email as empty string "" rather than sending null when the field is left blank, and CustomerCreate.email is typed Optional[EmailStr] which rejects empty-string input under pydantic's EmailStr validator. Any user who fills only the required Nama Customer field and skips the optional Email field cannot save a new customer.

action_items.item: Fix Customers.tsx create-customer mutation to send email as null (or omit the key) when the Email field is left blank, matching how phone/address/notes are treated, OR relax CustomerCreate.email validation to accept empty string as no-email.
